Adresse der Kimai-Instanz, z. B. https:/: Address of the Kimai instance, e.g. https://kimai.example.com (without /api).
Braucht in Kimai das Recht view_other_ti: Requires the view_other_timesheet permission in Kimai; otherwise only the token user's times are returned.
Bucht in workDiary erfasste Zeiten gemap: Posts times recorded in workDiary for mapped projects back as Kimai timesheets.
Bucht in workDiary erfasste, noch nicht: Posts times recorded in workDiary for mapped projects that have not yet been exported as Kimai timesheets (activity from the plugin settings). Entries already posted or imported from Kimai are skipped.
CSV mode — no API access stored.
Direkt aus der Kimai-API importieren: Import directly from the Kimai API
Holt Timesheets über die Kimai-REST-API: Fetches timesheets via the Kimai REST API (bearer token). With API access configured, this import runs hourly on its own; here you start it immediately. Without a period, the last :days days are queried; already imported entries are skipped.
Importiert Zeiteinträge aus Kimai (CSV-E: Imports time entries from Kimai (CSV export or REST API) and optionally posts recorded times back as Kimai timesheets.
Kein API-Zugang hinterlegt. Basis-URL un: No API access configured. Configure the base URL and API token in the plugin settings.
Kein Projekt ist einem Kimai-Projekt zug: No project is mapped to a Kimai project (run the API import first or post the mapping inbox groups).
Keine Kimai-Activity-ID hinterlegt — Rüc: No Kimai activity ID configured — write-back not possible.
Kimai 2.x: Profil → API-Zugang. Zusammen: Kimai 2.x: Profile → API access. Together with the base URL, this enables the API import.
Kimai → Zeiten → Export → CSV. Kunden/Pr: Kimai → Times → Export → CSV. Customers/projects are matched by name or remembered mappings; anything that cannot be matched ends up in the mapping inbox.
Kimai-API antwortet nicht (Ping fehlgesc: Kimai API is not responding (ping failed).
Kimai-API ist nicht konfiguriert (Basis-: Kimai API is not configured (set the base URL and API token in the plugin settings).
Kimai-API-Import: :created angelegt, :sk: Kimai API import: :created created, :skipped skipped, :unmatched open (inbox).
Kimai-Export ist deaktiviert (Plugin-Ein: Kimai export is disabled (plugin setting "Enable write-back").
Nur für eine selbst gehostete Kimai-Inst: Only for a self-hosted Kimai instance on your own network: allows a base URL with a private/internal address. This is audited and only takes effect if the operator permits it.
Pflicht für die Rückbuchung — Kimai verl: Required for write-back — Kimai requires an activity per timesheet.
Rückbuchung jetzt ausführen? Es werden T: Run write-back now? Timesheets will be created in Kimai.
Schreibt Korrekturen an bereits importie: Writes corrections to already imported times back to Kimai (changes and deletions). If the entry changed there in the meantime, nothing is overwritten — the case goes to the integration inbox. Invoiced times are never written back.
Zeiteinträge aus einem Kimai-Timesheet-C: Import time entries from a Kimai timesheet CSV export.
